question_text: Compare the average head_count at KeynoteHall_Stage between the morning keynote window 09:00-10:00 UTC and the afternoon keynote window 14:00-15:00 UTC on 2025-12-08. Which keynote had higher attendance and what were the approximate average head_counts?
answer_text: The morning keynote (09:00–10:00 UTC) had higher attendance: average head_count 450.19 (3,600 samples) versus the afternoon keynote (14:00–15:00 UTC) average 399.51 (3,600 samples). Community summaries note activity at the KeynoteHall (cameras include KeynoteHall_Stage) with person movements dominating and a reported peak head_count around 500.

citations.cypher:
CALL {
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour {camera_location: 'KeynoteHall_Stage'})
  WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T09:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-08T10:00:00Z'
  RETURN avg(ch.avg_hc) AS morning_avg, sum(ch.event_count) AS morning_samples
}
CALL {
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour {camera_location: 'KeynoteHall_Stage'})
  WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T14:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-08T15:00:00Z'
  RETURN avg(ch.avg_hc) AS afternoon_avg, sum(ch.event_count) AS afternoon_samples
}
RETURN morning_avg, morning_samples, afternoon_avg, afternoon_samples,
  CASE
    WHEN coalesce(morning_avg, 0.0) > coalesce(afternoon_avg, 0.0) THEN 'morning_09_10_higher'
    WHEN coalesce(afternoon_avg, 0.0) > coalesce(morning_avg, 0.0) THEN 'afternoon_14_15_higher'
    ELSE 'equal_or_no_data'
  END AS higher_attendance
